meta.name: before-you-build
meta.description: Pre-build product and feature risk review for founders, product managers, and AI-assisted builders. Use this skill when the user is about to build a landing page, MVP, SaaS product, internal tool, agent workflow, or major feature and needs to check demand, positioning, monetization, retention, trust, distribution, and adoption risk before implementation starts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你：是创始人或产品经理，想在投入开发前确认想法是否靠谱。
copy.tagline_en: Check product risks before you build
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a founder or PM validating a product idea before development.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在你动手实现之前先做一次构建前预检,产出:风险等级(低/中/高)、最可能出问题的一个假设、该先找的证据、下一步动作,以及应当暂缓构建的部分。
howto.when: 当你准备做落地页、MVP、新功能等尚未验证的东西时触发;若是小修小改、重构、测试修复等已有明确验收标准的改动,则跳过。

say.text: 我要做一个收费的知识库网站,先帮我做构建前风险检查
say.note: 输出风险等级与最该先验证的假设

say.text: 我打算给现有产品加一个 AI 功能,帮我评估采纳和留存风险
say.note: 给出该功能是否该现在做

say.text: 我想先做落地页验证需求,告诉我最小验证步骤是什么
say.note: 给出一个具体的最小验证动作

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude runs a compact pre-build pre-mortem before implementation: a risk verdict (low/medium/high), the main assumption, the first evidence to find, the next step, and what to delay.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you are about to build or ship a landing page, MVP, or major feature that isn't validated yet. Skips narrow fixes, refactors, test repairs, and dependency updates.

say_en.text: I want to build a paid knowledge-base site — run a pre-build risk review first.
say_en.note: Returns the risk verdict and the main assumption.

say_en.text: I'm adding an AI feature to my product — check adoption and retention risk.
say_en.note: Says whether to build it now or delay.

say_en.text: I'll validate demand with a landing page — what's the smallest evidence step?
